linkedin:
Only 22% of remote job listings disclose pay. For brand designers, that means rates are rare—but when they appear, they range from $1,500 to $5,000 per fixed project.

A new analysis of 3,940 active remote listings on Loker Dollar shows just 853 postings (22%) include any salary or rate. Among brand design roles, two examples stand out: Stevens offers $3,000–$5,000 for a fixed project, while Sidekicks Creative Studio lists $1,500–$3,000. Both are open to worldwide remote applicants.

Other disclosed roles include a social media video editor at $1,000–$2,000 per month and an operations lead at $2,000–$4,000 monthly. Only 64% of all listings accept worldwide remote talent, so competition is global.

The takeaway: if you're a freelancer, prioritize listings that publish rates. They give you a clearer benchmark than the 78% that stay silent. And remember, a lower retainer might offer steadier cash flow than a high-pressure fixed sprint.

Read the full breakdown and see the live roles: https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/remote-brand-designer-salary-trends-2026
